heroHeadline: China's Climate Centre Officially Confirms Super El Niño Emerged in September 2026
heroSubtitle: IRI's weekly Niño 3.4 anomaly hit +3.3°C for the week centered Oct 14, a fifth straight week above +3.0°C, while WMO projects an Oct–Dec average near +3.7°C.
